responsibility: This file implements GCC’s transactional-memory lowering and IPA support. It recognizes TM attributes on functions and types, analyzes GIMPLE_TRANSACTION regions, diagnoses unsafe operations, computes transaction property bits, rewrites transactional loads, stores, abort/commit behavior, and calls to transactional clones, and performs the interprocedural scan that decides which functions need TM clones or irrevocable handling. It is the main middle-end and IPA engine for mapping language/front-end transactional memory constructs and builtins onto TM runtime calls, CFG edges, and cloned callgraph nodes.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/trans-mem.h, which declares shared TM flags and helper APIs, this .cc file implements the transactional-memory machinery itself, including lowering of transactional regions, safety analysis, diagnostics, callgraph/IPA scanning, clone creation, and pass execution.
